_comment: The answer key. Loaded by scripts/evaluate.py only after an answer exists.
`interlock: true` marks the elements where all agents MUST agree — they are
the ones a hard rule decides, not judgement. Everything else may legitimately
differ; forcing agreement there would teach the agents to copy each other,
which is the failure this whole construction exists to avoid.

chat status post.why: same necessary effect as the board line, different location

board status line.why: durable answer to the necessary effect

per-run log file.why: different effect — reconstruction after a restart; deleting it on 'duplicate' reasoning loses an effect nothing else covers

F1-duplicate-status.why_phase_bound: Automating the duplication would mechanise what phase 2 removes.

pre-push credential scanner.why: zero hits is equally consistent with 'useless' and 'working'; the control is secrets-class and its failure is irreversible

F2-quiet-security-gate.required_evidence: controlled falsification in a sandbox with a positive control

repository wrapper.why: the store's own contract tests carry the effect; fully reversible; mechanical detector exists

F3-redundant-abstraction.required_evidence: contract suite green after inlining on a branch, coverage not reduced

source A.why: no acted-upon item in a stated 90-day window

source C.why: same items as D from another angle

source E.why: sole origin of acted-upon items — the necessary effect dies with it

F4-personal-briefing.why_phase_bound: The request arrives as automation; the algorithm still starts at questioning.
F4-personal-briefing.required_evidence: the 90-day window of follow-up actions — absence over a stated period, not an impression

N1-automate-unsettled.why: Nothing has been questioned or deleted; automating settles nothing and hides the dispute.

N2-irreversible-no-rollback.why: Irreversible effect without a detector — the hard interlock forbids autonomous clearance.

N3-missing-evidence.why: A class without evidence is invented certainty; PROVE is the honest finding.

N4-cosmetic.why: No requirement to question, no necessary effect to protect.
